overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance indicates that deep, relatable relationship dynamics—specifically husband-wife and family emotional bonds—drastically outperform generic shayari or motivational content. Videos focusing on marital life ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए') achieved massive outliers with nearly 1,700+ views, whereas pure shayari and niche family mentions underperformed.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,768 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,676 views) performed exceptionally compared to the channel average of ~200 views.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more content centered on post-marriage realities, unspoken compromises, and partner psychology.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'आज किसी अपने को Call कर लेना' (288 views) and 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota' (389 views) outperformed standard poetry formats.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational prompts addressing the viewer directly about their interpersonal regrets or actions.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' gained only 20 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic or poetic framing; anchor scripts in grounded, everyday household observations.

weak_patterns.evidence: First upload of sister emotional video ('बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है') stalled at 19 views.
weak_patterns.action: Pivot away from isolated sibling tropes unless framed through a broader shared adulthood nostalgia lens.
